# Borsoga Studio

> Borsoga Studio is a Miami-based architectural visualization studio. We create photoreal 3D renders, CGI, immersive 360° tours, cinematic video, custom sales websites and brand identity that let people experience a building or interior before it is built. We work with real estate developers, architects, general contractors and custom millwork specialists — based in Miami, FL and working globally.

Tagline: "Digital spaces for the unbuilt imagination."

## What we do

- Architectural visualization & 3D rendering — exteriors, interiors, amenities
- Photorealistic CGI and still renders
- Immersive 360° virtual tours and walkthroughs
- Cinematic walkthrough and aerial video
- Architectural & interior photography and material studies
- Custom sales websites, web platforms and iOS sales apps
- Brand identity, naming and visual systems

## Who we work with

- Real estate developers & investors — sell pre-construction before it is built, with photoreal renders, video, 360° tours, project branding and a dedicated sales site.
- Architects & general contractors — translate CAD, materials and lighting into images that read the same to every stakeholder, so bids close and projects break ground faster.
- Custom millwork & carpentry specialists — workshop identity, a portfolio site, and finished pieces rendered in the client's actual room to justify a premium quote.

## Common questions

### What is Borsoga Studio?
Borsoga Studio is a Miami-based architectural visualization and CGI studio. It produces photoreal 3D renders, immersive 360° tours, cinematic video, custom sales websites and brand identity that let people experience a building or interior before it is built. It works with real estate developers, architects, general contractors and custom millwork specialists, based in Miami and working globally.

### What is architectural visualization?
Architectural visualization is the process of turning architectural plans, sketches and 3D models into accurate, photorealistic images, animations and immersive tours. It lets developers, architects and buyers see and evaluate a space before it is built. Borsoga Studio focuses on natural light, true human scale and honest material representation to convey the real feeling of a space.

### Where is Borsoga Studio located?
Borsoga Studio is based in Miami, Florida, USA, and works with clients globally. It can be reached at info@borsogastudio.com or +1 786-852-4847.

### Who does Borsoga Studio work with?
Borsoga Studio works with three main client types: real estate developers and investors who need to sell pre-construction before it is built; architects and general contractors who need drawings translated into images every stakeholder understands; and custom millwork and carpentry specialists who need brand identity and renders that justify a premium quote.

### Can you visualize a building before it is built?
Yes. Borsoga Studio specializes in pre-construction visualization — photoreal renders, cinematic walkthrough and aerial video, and immersive 360° tours that let a buyer stand inside a unit before the slab is poured. This helps developers take reservations earlier and defend their pitch to lenders and capital partners.

### What software does Borsoga Studio use?
Borsoga Studio's architectural visualization work is built primarily with V-Ray and Rhino, producing photorealistic CGI renders, animations and immersive environments.
